select a.id as id, a.id as after_sale_id, a.after_sale_no, a.order_id, a.order_item_id, a.order_no, a.user_name, a.student_name, item.goods_id, coalesce(g.goods_name, item.goods_name) as product_name, g.goods_code as product_code, g.category_name as category_name, coalesce(item.main_image, g.main_image) as image_url, coalesce(oi.supplier_id, g.supplier_id, a.supplier_id) as supplier_id, coalesce(oi.supplier_name, g.supplier_name) as manufacturer_name, item.unit_price as price, coalesce(a.finish_time, a.update_time, a.create_time) as operate_time, a.status, item.size_name, a.target_size_name, a.apply_num, a.reason, a.images_json, a.audit_by, a.audit_time, a.handle_result, a.handle_remark, a.finish_time, a.create_time, a.dept_id from xfpt_after_sale a left join xfpt_order_info oi on a.order_id = oi.id and oi.del_flag = '0' left join xfpt_order_item item on a.order_item_id = item.id and item.del_flag = '0' left join xfpt_goods g on item.goods_id = g.id and g.del_flag = '0'
a.del_flag = '0' and a.apply_type = '3' and a.dept_id = #{deptId}
and a.status = #{status}
and coalesce(oi.supplier_name, g.supplier_name) like concat('%', #{manufacturerName}, '%')
and g.status = #{productStatus}
and g.category_name like concat('%', '校服', '%')
and g.category_name like concat('%', '运动', '%')
and g.category_name like concat('%', '书包', '%')
and g.category_name like concat('%', #{productCategory}, '%')
and (coalesce(g.goods_name, item.goods_name) like concat('%', '春', '%') or coalesce(g.goods_name, item.goods_name) like concat('%', '秋', '%'))
and coalesce(g.goods_name, item.goods_name) like concat('%', '夏', '%')
and coalesce(g.goods_name, item.goods_name) like concat('%', '冬', '%')
and coalesce(g.goods_name, item.goods_name) like concat('%', #{productStyle}, '%')
order by operate_time desc, a.id desc

select a.id as id, a.id as after_sale_id, a.after_sale_no, a.order_id, a.order_item_id, a.order_no, a.user_name, a.student_name, item.goods_id, coalesce(g.goods_name, item.goods_name) as product_name, g.goods_code as product_code, g.category_name as category_name, coalesce(item.main_image, g.main_image) as image_url, coalesce(oi.supplier_id, g.supplier_id, a.supplier_id) as supplier_id, coalesce(oi.supplier_name, g.supplier_name) as manufacturer_name, item.unit_price as price, coalesce(a.finish_time, a.update_time, a.create_time) as operate_time, a.status, item.size_name, a.target_size_name, a.apply_num, a.reason, a.images_json, a.audit_by, a.audit_time, a.handle_result, a.handle_remark, a.finish_time, a.create_time, a.dept_id from xfpt_after_sale a left join xfpt_order_info oi on a.order_id = oi.id and oi.del_flag = '0' left join xfpt_order_item item on a.order_item_id = item.id and item.del_flag = '0' left join xfpt_goods g on item.goods_id = g.id and g.del_flag = '0' where a.del_flag = '0' and a.apply_type = '3' and a.id = #{id} and a.dept_id = #{deptId}
